# Vendored WOFF2 decoder

- Upstream: <https://github.com/google/woff2>
- Commit: `fb9c3379f2605b10f3e8f1d9636664ab5576775c`

Only the public decoder headers, decoder/common implementation, and their
private headers are present. Encoder, command-line, info, normalization,
transform, fuzzing, and test sources are intentionally excluded.
